name: Luna Treasure Compass
desc:
A compass that can be used in Nod-Krai and the Frost Moon to search for nearby treasures and relevant clues.
This sublunary sphere holds countless unknown treasures, waiting to be discovered by adventurers with courage or wit.

value.name: Meeting Point: Frostmoon Enclave
value.desc: Here, the Frostmoon Scions gather, listening to the teachings of moonlight.

value.name: Meeting Point: Clink-Clank Krumkake Craftshop
value.desc: A genius and her invention reside here. By their powers combined, they shall surely create the most delicious krumkakes the world has ever seen.

value.name: Meeting Point: Final Night Cemetery
value.desc: A certain Ratnik resides here. Though he lives alone, he faithfully fulfills his duties.

value.name: Meeting Point: Favonius Keep
value.desc: The campsite where the Knights of Favonius expeditionary force is stationed. Here, the gentle, warm breeze carries the distinct scent of Dandelion Wine.

value.name: Meeting Point: The Witch's Garden
value.desc: Legend has it that the witch's hut rests deep within the garden, and its true form can only be beheld by the pure of heart.

value.name: Meeting Point: Cliffwatch Camp
value.desc: This camp, built by the Lightkeepers' investigation squad, serves as a long-standing sentinel watching against threats from the north.

value.name: Nuur Stone Circle
value.desc: The silent stones stand here like a gravestone for a bygone age.

value.name: Curtain-Form Blackbody Containment Lab
value.desc: A Moonshade Tree, shaped through selective gene tuning, spreads its branches wide. The blackbody matter it emits can form a vast screen, shielding this place from prying eyes and hostile observation.

customize.text: You must unlock the Compass and increase your exploration ability before it can mark the locations of lost Oculi on the Map.

Once your exploration ability is sufficiently advanced, the Compass can mark clues related to hidden treasures. If you want you claim these treasures for yourself, you'll still need to solve the clues...

The current Meeting Point Level has been increased to 1, which has unlocked the Luna Treasure Compass' exploration ability in the present area:
Can display the current area's <color=#ffe04b>treasure and relevant clues.</color>

The current Meeting Point Level has been increased to 3, which has further enhanced the exploration ability of the Luna Treasure Compass in the current area:
Can display <color=#ffe04b>Oculi</color> , and can display <color=#ffe04b>up to 10 treasures and relevant clues</color> , including Oculi, at once.

The current Meeting Point Level has been increased to 5.
The Compass' exploration ability is increased to the maximum:
Can display <color=#ffe04b>all Oculi, as well as most treasures and relevant clues in the current area</color> .

customize.name: Anemo Treasure Compass
customize.desc:
A compass that can be used in Mondstadt to search for nearby chests.
The needle of the Treasure Compass doesn't spin according to the world's magnetic field, but rather follows the energy of ley lines to lead the user to treasure.

customize.name: Geo Treasure Compass
customize.desc:
A compass that can be used in Liyue to search for nearby chests.
The land of Geo is rich with valuable resources, with treasures hidden throughout the mountains and wilderness just waiting to be found.

customize.name: Electro Treasure Compass
customize.desc:
A handy tool used to locate nearby chests in Inazuma.
The land of the thundering archipelago has suffered a great many past hurts. The many treasure chests that dot the islands is a symbol of its revival from these wounds.

customize.name: Dendro Treasure Compass
customize.desc:
A compass that can be used in Sumeru to search for nearby chests.

For some people, the significance of life lies in exploration and discovery. Upon reaching each destination, there is always bountiful treasure awaiting.

customize.name: Hydro Treasure Compass
customize.desc:
A compass that can be used in Fontaine to search for nearby chests.

These chests scattered across Fontaine are not the lawful property of any individual or organization. In most circumstances, it is legal to claim the contents found within.

customize.name: Pyro Treasure Compass
customize.desc:
A compass that can be used in Natlan to search for nearby chests.
Amidst the turmoil and strife that wrack the land, many treasures throughout the vast Nation of Pyro have gone unaccounted for, all trace of their whereabouts lost.

customize.name: Segment-Domain Treasure Compass
customize.desc:
When used within the Temple of Space, this device detects nearby treasures and the related clues.
Even within the hidden vaults where the thousand winds cannot reach, there are still invisible threads that guide the way toward the most precious of collections — as well as the hidden meanings behind them.

customize.name: Cryo Treasure Compass
customize.desc:
A compass that can be used in Snezhnaya to search for nearby treasure and relevant clues.
Many treasures lie frozen in hidden places across the land of snow. Those who can undo the seals may claim the gifts left within the ice.
